why.home OVERLAP (Nov 18, 30 findings): false alarms, checked on pictures at 320/390/820/1280/1920: the boxes are the line boxes of slanted Unbounded at display sizes (line height 0.9-1.1), which reach into the next line; the letters stay apart. Pairs: the hero tags' name over its rating (Rillaboom x 97 ...), the tagline's two lines (Sharply raise x your win rate.), the Dispatch masthead's two lines, the tools' big numbers over their labels (13,631 x tournament teams, 115 x events), the receipt's title over the score (Your Strength Score x 94).
why.home SIZE (Nov 18, 6 findings): intended: fluid display tokens (--d-sdsix 'Call six out of the herd.', --d-sdof '/100', the hero tags' score) that scale with their box between the scale's steps; qcheck counts only sizes under 40px, and these reach 40 at other widths. Same kind as the design scale's display sizes.
why.news OVERLAP + SIZE (Nov 18, 6 findings): the Dispatch's lead story, from the daily news document (out/post.json, meta/post; the lead changes with the news). OVERLAP: false alarm, checked on pictures at 820 and 1280: the headline link's inline box (69px tall for 55.6px slanted Unbounded at line height 1.04) reaches 4px up into the kicker's box (CAMPAIGN · NOV 25); the letters stay apart. SIZE 37.0px (36.1 measured) at 820: the fluid display token --d-lead, between the scale's steps by design, as Home's.
